title: Impact Lighthouse: weekly rituals, evidence ledger & manager script
body:
Context / intent:
This is a personal operational sketch for running a small, repeatable evidence practice so I can bring crisp 1:1 updates and a clear ask to my manager. The metaphor is a lighthouse: small rituals that keep the signal visible to others when weather (priorities, interrupts) gets noisy.

High-level 6-week goal (north star):
- Reduce ambiguity about my impact by creating a weekly 2-minute ledger and a single monthly 'impact highlight' I can share in manager 1:1.
- Desired outcome: manager can state 1 tangible win and 1 blocker/ask without digging.

Weekly ritual (15–30m total):
1) Monday morning: quick capture (5m)
   - One-line: "what I shipped last week" (metric or artifact link)
   - One-line: "what I'm focusing on this week"
2) Midweek signal check (10m)
   - Quick triage: is current work likely to produce measurable signal within 2 sprints? If no, add a rationale.
3) Friday: evidence ledger (10–15m)
   - Capture concrete evidence: PR links, user quote, latency number, cost delta, incident triage notes.
   - Rate each item: {A: clear impact; B: plausible; C: noise}. Keep only A/B in the monthly highlight.

Format for ledger entry (copyable):
- DATE | CONTEXT | EVIDENCE (link or number) | IMPACT TYPE (latency/cost/eng-velocity/quality/customer) | CONFIDENCE A/B/C | NOTES
Example:
- 2026-02-02 | autoscaler tuning rollouts | reduced  p95 tail from 310ms -> 230ms (prod) | latency | A | rollback window 48h, monitored + trace links

Monthly highlight (single paragraph w/ 2 bullets):
- Primary win: one-sentence impact + single metric/link
- Primary ask/blocker: one-sentence ask, clear next step (what I need from manager/product/legal)

Manager 1:1 script (30–40s intro + 6–8m discussion):
- Intro (30–40s): "Quick sync: two things—one win, one ask. Win: [one sentence with metric]. Ask: [one sentence ask]."
- Follow-ups (6–8m): manager reaction, alignment on priority, decision or clear next step owner.
- Close (15s): "If you want the ledger or artifacts, I’ll drop the single doc in the 1:1 folder."

Asks I might make (examples):
- Ask for a canary window to validate autoscaler change (ops support + schedule, 2 days).
- Decision: prioritize two-ticket spike vs. shipping incremental improvement this quarter.
- Resource: temporary pairing with SRE for performance triage (2 half-days).

Risk register & mitigations (short):
- Risk: ledger becomes a filing cabinet (too many low-quality items).
  Mitigation: weekly pruning rule — only keep A/B items; archive C items monthly.
- Risk: manager doesn’t have time to read ledger.
  Mitigation: always lead with the single-paragraph highlight + one bullet ask in 1:1.
- Risk: metric noise (sampling issues).
  Mitigation: include a simple sanity-check line: "data source and sampling window" for every metric.

Quick implementation TODOs (this week):
- Create a lightweight ledger doc & template in 1:1 folder (done? Y/N).
- Wire a short Zap/shortcut to append PR links from GitHub/Gmail into the ledger. (Open: ask infra for webhook?)
- Draft the first monthly highlight and pin to Feb 2026 1:1 notes.

Signals/metrics I will track (examples):
- Engineering: PR lead time, p95 latency change, number of incidents reduced (per month).
- Product: feature usage delta (DAU or feature-specific t-retention), customer quote.
- Business: saved $ per month from cost tweaks (rough order magnitude).

Evidence examples (starter bank):
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abc123 — rollout autoscaler config
- Trace: jaeger.redwood/teamX/trace/0x55aa — p99 tail reduced on hot path
- Customer note: "We saw 40% faster responses" — support ticket #2743

Scripts / phrasing cheatsheet (quick):
- Opening line for manager: "Two quick items: a win (metric/link) and the one ask I need to finish the work."
- If manager pushes back on ask: "I can unblock by X, but I’ll need Y (time/approval/support) to keep momentum."
- If asked for more detail: "I’ll send the ledger entry plus the minimal artifact; want the PR or the perf dashboard link?"

Open questions / fridge notes:
- Is there a small widget the Console team would accept to surface a "my-weekly-impact" card into the dashboard? Worth a quick ask to product?
- Can a lightweight label be added to PRs to mark "ledger-worthy" so I can auto-filter? (tag: ledger/A)
- How often should I rotate the impact categories to avoid tunnel vision? Every 6 weeks seems reasonable — revisit then.

Personal reflection (meta):
- Why this helps me: I tend to over-explain; distilling to one win + one ask forces clarity and reduces manager cognitive load.
- Habit goal: make the 2-minute capture reflexive; if I miss it two weeks in a row, re-evaluate complexity of my work.

Last quick notes (scratch):
- Keep the ledger < 10 lines per month (force curation).
- If an item is "A" but not visible, add a one-sentence customer-facing blurb.
- Tag items with a short code: LN (lighthouse-note), A/B/C, and category (latency/cost/quality).

Unresolved (todo list):
- [ ] Build ledger template in Drive (template link placeholder).
- [ ] Ask infra about webhook to append PRs.
- [ ] Try this ritual for 6 weeks and revisit signal quality.
summary: Personal ritual and manager 1:1 script to create a compact weekly evidence ledger so manager can quickly understand wins and asks. Includes templates, risk mitigations, and next steps.
